answer: Locks are recorded in pulse, expire in juniper, and marble lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 183 aliases hence needs 72 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3907 identities would post 2591 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
